notes:
# How Aerchain looks, moves and sounds

This is Aerchain's current brand, from the guideline at individual-core-687035.framer.app/home-ets. The older purple brand (#4A3ACA, Parkinsans, gradients) is retired: don't use it.

## The big idea

**Light reveals structure. Intelligence surfaces only the part that matters.**

Every Aerchain piece tells the same short story:

1. Start with complexity.
2. Separate what matters from the noise.
3. Mark the one point where intelligence acts.

Procurement data isn't hidden. Risks, approvals, clauses, spend patterns and supplier details already exist, scattered across systems. The problem is scale. So the guideline's motto is **"Nothing hidden. Everything buried."** and its poster line is **"Complexity in. Outcome owned."**: many lines go in, one lit outcome comes out.

## 1. Light

Light is how intelligence becomes visible. Wherever it appears, in photos, graphics, surfaces or motion, it means one thing: something important has been surfaced, clarified or moved forward.

There are five kinds of light:

| Light | What it is | Use it for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Edge Light** | A narrow edge catching light from one side | Architectural edges, card edges, dividers, structural surfaces |
| **Cast Shadow** | The shadow that light leaves behind | Depth, material, rhythm, and proof the light is real |
| **Beam Light** | A plane or ray travelling from a clear source | Architectural edges, card edges, dividers, structural surfaces |
| **Refraction** | A beam splitting at one point | Keep it grey and orange, directional, structural and simple |
| **Point Light** | One small mark of light | An anomaly, a signal, a decision, a resolved state, a data point |

Draw light as one clean shape, such as a beam, a V or a funnel, with one tone inside. Stepped heights read as a bar chart, so avoid them.

## 2. The line field

Parallel lines are the foundation. Every graphic is built from this one grid.

- **The 2:1 rule.** The gap is always exactly half the stroke. Scale them together and never change the ratio. In 1080p films: 8 px lines, 4 px gaps, a 12 px pitch.
- **One stroke, one colour.** Each line is one continuous flat stroke in one colour. Lines flow one way. They never bend back or drop to the floor.
- **Darker gaps.** Each colour is a flat field with slightly darker gaps: black #1E1E1E with #141414, orange #F55A00 with #DB5000, stone #D3CCBF with #C2BAAC. Black gaps through orange or stone look like loud barcode stripes, so don't.
- **Three roles.** The same field can be quiet or loud:
  - **Background:** texture only. It can move freely and needs no light source.
  - **Supporting:** carries structure.
  - **Hero:** carries structure and the only orange, at the point of action.
- **Copy on grey.** Text can run over the field, but never over orange or the lit part.

**Signal Fields** are line fields with meaning: every line stands for something real, such as a supplier, bid, PO, contract, invoice, workflow or data signal. The point of action is the moment one lit line resolves them all: *"Every rate, risk, and approval, scattered, until one moment resolves them."*

Signature pieces built this way:

- **Complexity in. Outcome owned.** Many lines in, one orange outcome. Also shown with a person's silhouette over orange lines.
- **The Human Checkpoint.** Lines pass through two chamfered brackets around an orange outline person: the moment a human approves or decides.
- **The Point of Action.** One orange element resolves a busy field: *"Aerchain surfaces what matters the moment it happens, not in next quarter's report."*
- **The SpendOS launch poster.** The wordmark, SpendOS in large type, the triangle A in an orange circle, "Unveiled live at the Agentic Workshop" and "RAI Amsterdam, 29 Sept to 1 Oct".

The guideline's pattern tool makes these fields in seven modes (Falloff, Steps, Resolve, Prism, Signal, Comb, Wave), four arrangements (Single, Dual, Triple, Mirror), any ratio from 1:1 to 21:9 and four directions. The light can stay fixed, follow the cursor or move on its own, and it exports SVG. Use these names when asking for a field.

## 3. Colour

Three ramps, each 16 steps from light to dark:

- **Signal** (orange), anchor Signal 9 #F55A00. Orange means "this is the resolved action", so it appears **once per screen**.
- **Stone** (warm neutral), anchor Stone 9 #837E73. Grounds and most surfaces.
- **Steel** (blue grey), anchor Steel 850 #7E858B, named Steel 50 to 1550. Systems, data and supporting structure.

Films use tuned values from the Aerchain speaker post (the "Film fields" ramp): stone ground #E9E5DD, ink #141414, muted copy #6B665E, black field #1E1E1E, orange #F55A00. Keep them: the shipped films use them.

**Flat colour only.** Nothing glows, blurs or casts a drop shadow.

## 4. Shape and buttons

**The cut corner is the shadow.** Depth comes from one chamfer, never from shadows.

- The chamfer goes on the **bottom-right corner only**. A second chamfer contradicts the light.
- The cut is **a quarter of the height**, rounded to the nearest pixel. A 24 px button cuts 6 px.
- When pressed, the chamfer closes and the button goes flat.

Buttons come in five sizes (XS, S, M, L, XL) and five kinds:

| Button | Looks like | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Primary** | Signal orange fill, dark label. One per screen | Book a demo |
| **Secondary** | Dark fill | Know more |
| **Tertiary** | Named in the guideline, without detail | |
| **Ghost** | Outline only | Cancel |
| **Agent** | Orange outline with the Intelligence Square. The only orange outlined button | Run supplier match |

## 5. Icons

Two kinds, chosen by whether intelligence is involved. They share the look but not the grid.

- **Outline icons** are for ordinary actions and objects: thin even strokes on a 14 x 14 grid, a 1 unit stroke and corners cut at 40 degrees.
- **AI-touched icons** are drawn by lighting up parts of the line field, like pixels on a striped ground. Orange is the part where intelligence acted; grey is the system underneath. Both kinds come in light and dark.

## 6. Photography and material

Procurement is physical, so Aerchain shows the real world behind it.

- **Photography:** architecture and structure in strong directional light, long hard shadows, light through glass and slats, sunsets over cities, warm orange light against grey and black. Never cheerful stock-office photos.
- **Material:** real surfaces such as corrugated board, folded paper and card, and steel structure. Material isn't decoration: it stands for the world procurement runs in.

## 7. Type

**Bricolage Grotesque** for all Aerchain artwork, the same face the guideline is set in. Inter appears only inside interface widgets.

- Headlines: SemiBold 600, the opsz axis at display size, tracking -1%.
- Body: Regular 400.
- A print example (an A4 cover, in points): eyebrow 10, weight 500, tracking +0.1; title 50, SemiBold 600, leading 1.0, tracking -0.5; subtitle 13, weight 400, leading 1.4; tagline 11.5, weight 500; footer 7.5, weight 400, tracking +0.1.
- In Figma, SVG text stays editable only when the font family is the PostScript name (BricolageGrotesque-SemiBold). A weight alone turns 600 into Bold and drops the letter spacing.

## 8. Logo

- **The AERCHAIN wordmark** is the main signature. Letters are black on light grounds and light stone on dark grounds. The "ai" mark is always orange #F55A00: never recolour it or add effects.
- Give it clear space of at least its letter height.
- **The lockup** adds "AI-NATIVE SPEND OS" under the wordmark, between short orange rules (logos/lockup-spend-os.svg, for light grounds).
- **The white wordmark** (logos/wordmark-white.svg) is for dark grounds.
- The **ai mark** alone can sign small pieces. Some posters sign off with the **triangle A** and "Aerchain".

## 9. Motion

- Colour arrives **from the right**, line by line, bottom line first like a rising staircase, and leaves the way it came.
- Moves start gently and settle into place. No bounce, no overshoot.
- Orange lands **last and once**: the point of action.
- Black returns from the middle outwards to close a loop.
- The cover frame (the "Cover" mark) shows the resolved idea.

## 10. Sound

Clean, minimal and digital: soft ticks, filtered whooshes as colour arrives from the right, a low pulse underneath, and one bright accent when orange lands. Never cheesy or busy. Leave room for speech and dip the music under it. Aim for about -16 LUFS on social.

## 11. Words

- Write **Aerchain** in copy. AERCHAIN in capitals is only the wordmark.
- **SpendOS** is one word, with a capital S and OS.
- Plain, confident sentences about outcomes, not features.
- No em dashes.

## Where it's used

The same system makes LinkedIn results posts ("18% off spend. Across 230 suppliers."), speaker posts (name, title and portrait on stone with lines) and event posts (date, time and title).
